passages.title: Community Library Membership
passages.intro: Information for new members and regular borrowers
paras: Residents can join the library without paying a membership fee. Applicants must show proof of address when they register.
Each member may borrow up to eight items at one time. The standard loan period for books is three weeks.
Items can be renewed unless another reader has reserved them. The library does not charge late fees on children's books.
Public computers may be reserved in one-hour sessions. The quiet study room closes at 7 p.m. each weekday.

passages.title: Community Fitness Centre
passages.intro: Opening hours, facilities and membership conditions
paras: Before using the gym, new members must complete a short safety induction. The swimming pool opens at 6:30 a.m. from Monday to Friday.
The family swim session is held on Sunday afternoons. Members may hire towels at reception for a small fee.
Class bookings can be cancelled without penalty up to six hours before the start. Lockers operate with a refundable coin deposit.
Children younger than twelve must remain under adult supervision. The centre closes on all public holidays.
